versions.changelog: 完善技能文档，添加workspace/run/mcp等命令说明，添加workspace脚本
添加标签和OpenClaw自动使用说明
添加 workspace 配置说明
补充安装说明：内网npm和SSO登录

Initial release of CodeFlicker CLI programming assistant.

- Provides CLI-based AI programming assistance similar to Codex CLI.
- Allows model selection and approval mode configuration.
- Supports both interactive and quiet (non-interactive) modes.
- Can continue or resume previous sessions.
- Offers quick reference for main commands and configuration.
- Requires login and may need internal npm registry for installation.
